name: Ajani Goldmane
description: Ajani Goldmane is a white-furred, one-eyed leonin planeswalker from Naya, a warrior and healer known as Elspeth's old friend and mentor and as a member of the Gatewatch.

summary.text: Ajani Goldmane is a white-furred, one-eyed leonin planeswalker from Naya, a warrior and healer known as Elspeth's old friend and mentor and as a member of the Gatewatch.

bio.text: He traveled to Theros searching for his friend Elspeth, with whom he had fought Xenagos, and later carried her dying body out of Nyx.
On Kaladesh he rescued Chandra and Nissa, healed Mrs. Pashiri, joined the Gatewatch by speaking its oath, and warned the group about Bolas, whom he had once defeated.
He fought in the War of the Spark and reminded Gideon of the Oath.

After helping Karn warn the leaders of the Phyrexian return, he was revealed to be a compleated spy and traitor, and as a follower of Elesh Norn he fought Elspeth, beheaded Sheoldred, and was sent to convert the gods of Theros.
Chandra says he killed Jaya Ballard, and Nahiri accuses him of slaughtering Theros's gods.
He was captured alive, cleansed along with Nissa, and later appeared restored and still able to planeswalk, proposing that he and Nahiri atone together.
On Tarkir he lived in isolation, haunted by guilt, then confessed to Elspeth that he had joined Phyrexia willingly, apologized for trying to kill her, and chose to fight beside her in the present.
He later became Kirol's advisor at Strixhaven, fought Chandra to stop her killing the archaic, and then joined her against Jace's plan to overwrite the Multiverse in Reality Fracture.

status.text: As of the latest story that shows him, Ajani is alive and, with Chandra, had just comforted Vraska over Jace's death before his double attacked.

timeline.summary: Flashback: from Kruphix's Temple, Kydele watches Xenagos become a god and Elspeth, with Ajani, use Godsend to cut him from the sky.
timeline.quote: She saw Elspeth use the blade called Godsend to cut Xenagos from the sky.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals that Theros is one of many worlds and that world-walkers like Elspeth, Ajani, Kiora and Xenagos have walked between them.
timeline.quote: So was the triton—the merfolk—Kiora, who called herself Callaphe and earned the ire of Thassa.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

timeline.summary: Ajani travels across Theros, reflecting on gods and on Naya, and camps in the mountains hoping leonin will find him.
timeline.quote: He made camp in the fading light, without stealth or subterfuge.

timeline.summary: Ajani notices the night sky lacks its usual constellations and has a void where no star shines.
timeline.quote: Worse, in one corner of the sky, there was simply blankness, a void where no star shone.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

timeline.summary: Seza's patrol finds Ajani at dawn and recognizes him.
timeline.quote: You are Seza," said Ajani, yawning, "and the last time I was here, you were too young to go out on patrol."

timeline.summary: Seza reveals that Brimaz is now king after Queen Omala died fighting humans, and that he declined vengeance.
timeline.quote: The queen, Omala, had died in battle with humans.

timeline.summary: Seza tells Ajani the gods vanished, leaving a ring of blank sky called the Moat of Oblivion.
timeline.quote: One day, the gods just... went away.

timeline.summary: Ajani reaches Tethmos and is reunited with Brimaz, who jokes about his title.
timeline.quote: Brimaz snorted, and soon the two leonin were chortling and embracing.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Brimaz for help finding his friend Elspeth, and Brimaz points him to Lanathos.
timeline.quote: You should talk to Lanathos," said Brimaz.

timeline.summary: Ajani introduces himself to Lanathos and asks about Elspeth; Lanathos eagerly asks where Ajani is from.
timeline.quote: There are people across the mountains? Leonin and human?

timeline.summary: Lanathos explains that the Champion of the Sun is a title, and that the latest champion killed Polukranos about a month ago.
timeline.quote: Very recently. During the Silence of the gods. A month ago, perhaps slightly more.

timeline.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
timeline.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

timeline.summary: Ajani resolves to find Elspeth and help her.
timeline.quote: After all, the Champion always has companions.

timeline.summary: Kiora leaps onto the back of Arixmethes and reveals to Ajani and Elspeth that she is not Callaphe, then leaves them to the Monsoon.
timeline.quote: "Not even close," Kiora replied, smiling back at him.

timeline.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
timeline.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

timeline.summary: Ajani wears mechanical gauntlets made for him by Glint-Sleeves at Grandmother Pashiri's request while infiltrating Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: They'd been crafted by the Glint-Sleeves, a group that specialized in such bodily attachments.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Grandmother Pashiri's building surrounded by Consulate inspectors.
timeline.quote: Grandmother's building was surrounded.

timeline.summary: Ajani sneaks into her ransacked home and knocks two inspectors' heads together.
timeline.quote: His metal-shrouded hands caught and knocked their heads together.

timeline.summary: Ajani pins the supervisor to a wall and demands to know where Grandmother Pashiri is.
timeline.quote: Where is Grandmother Pashiri?

timeline.summary: The supervisor says she is in custody, trapped as a renegade, and Ajani knocks him out, saying he no longer kills.
timeline.quote: I don't kill.

timeline.summary: Ajani follows Grandmother's attar scent across the city like a tracker.
timeline.quote: It was a different kind of jungle, but he was a tracker.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, six months ago, Nashi plays hide-and-seek in Tamiyo's library on Kamigawa and finds a pale giant, Ajani, who is welcomed into the household.
timeline.quote: A pale giant stared down at him. One blue eye blinked.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
timeline.quote: He's part of our family now.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
timeline.quote: Where is Elspeth?

timeline.summary: A blade at his back reveals Shadowblayde, who confirms he is a renegade ally with a secret phrase.
timeline.quote: A slight pressure settled against the back of his cloak, just hard enough for him to know it as the point of a blade.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde says she came looking for Renegade Prime and fears the Consuls took them, and offers to take Ajani to a renegade safe house.
timeline.quote: I came here looking for Renegade Prime. She was overdue.

timeline.summary: At the safe house Tamni tells Ajani that Consulate men with a false-armed leader arrested Pia and that Mrs. Pashiri led two women toward Kujar.
timeline.quote: when I got there, the Consulate had her surrounded

timeline.summary: Ajani counsels Tamni that charging rashly into battle is foolishness.
timeline.quote: To charge rashly into battle, unprepared, is not courage.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde has Dayal gather renegade lifecrafters with mechanical creatures to search for Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Dayal! Gather the troops.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains that thousands of lifecrafted creatures across Ghirapur can search faster than one giant.
timeline.quote: But there's thousands of little creations like ours in Ghirapur.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?

timeline.summary: Tamiyo comforts the sobbing Nashi and tells Ajani that actions have consequences.
timeline.quote: Actions have consequences,

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde learns through Mihir's bird that Pashiri was spotted at the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Pashiri was spotted twenty minutes ago.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
timeline.quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Shadowblayde to prepare a fast, secret escape route while he goes in alone.
timeline.quote: Can you find us a means of escape? Something fast. Secret.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde gives Ajani a mechanical bird to lead him to a Dhund entrance.
timeline.quote: When you're close to a Dhund entrance, he'll fly to it.

timeline.summary: Ajani shows his face to Shadowblayde, who tells him her real name, Vatti.
timeline.quote: That's my mundane name. Vatti.

timeline.summary: Following the mechanical bird, Ajani enters the Dhund and knocks out a guard.
timeline.quote: He backhanded the guard into the wall and winced at the sudden scent of blood.

timeline.summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
timeline.quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

timeline.summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
timeline.quote: To find the man who killed your family.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Nashi that Elspeth is dead and that he lost her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth is dead.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells the children Elspeth's story, saying a monster struck her down in front of him.
timeline.quote: another monster struck her down

timeline.summary: Ajani whispers that it should have been him, not Elspeth, and the children comfort him.
timeline.quote: It should have been me. Not her.

timeline.summary: Ajani vaults the rail, sheds Grandmother's cloak and gauntlets and attacks the guards at the poison chamber.
timeline.quote: They unclasped and fell away.

timeline.summary: Ajani swings for a guard's throat but reads his soul and decides he is just a man.
timeline.quote: Not a Planeswalker. Not a villain.

timeline.summary: Ajani smashes the guard's chestplate without killing him and sends the other fleeing.
timeline.quote: It smashed across the guard's chestplate, scattering twisted metal shards across the marble floor.

timeline.summary: Ajani pries open the poison container door with his axe.
timeline.quote: he peeled the screeching machine open.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
timeline.quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Grandmother Pashiri's poisoned blood.
timeline.quote: burning away the black, filling her blood with clean air

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Chandra's poisoned blood and lungs.
timeline.quote: Silver tendrils of healing magic raced through her, cleansing the impurities

timeline.summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
timeline.quote: We have a ride,

timeline.summary: Ajani lets the guard he struck go home, repeating that he does not kill anymore.
timeline.quote: Go home to your family,

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

timeline.summary: Chandra decides to face Tezzeret's challenge despite the risk of another trap.
timeline.quote: He's calling me out,

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

timeline.summary: Ajani asks what the Gatewatch is.
timeline.quote: What's a Gatewatch?

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

timeline.summary: Saheeli tells Chandra and Pia that the inventions of the Fair and Rashmi are gone.
timeline.quote: I think they took Rashmi and the others

timeline.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
timeline.quote: He's building something

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
timeline.quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
timeline.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

timeline.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
timeline.quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

timeline.summary: Gideon keeps Chandra on the ship while Nissa and Ajani join Pia on the ground team.
timeline.quote: "I'll go along with the ground team," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
timeline.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

timeline.summary: The ground team fights through automata and peacewalkers around the turret; Shadowblayde is caught in a peacewalker's treads.
timeline.quote: She lost her footing and fell sideways, dragged toward the spikes as she struggled to release herself.

timeline.summary: Ajani frees Shadowblayde from the treads and Nissa lifts the peacewalker to save them.
timeline.quote: Nissa stood under the chassis, her arms holding up the great mechanical beast

timeline.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

timeline.summary: Gideon invites Ajani to join the Gatewatch, and Ajani speaks the oath.
timeline.quote: "Never again," said Ajani. "Until all have found their place, I will keep watch."

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals he once defeated Bolas in the Maelstrom, warns against going to Amonkhet and asks them to gather allies first.
timeline.quote: "Give me time to get some of those friends together.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

timeline.summary: Thopter lightning strikes Mrs. Pashiri on the Hub platform after Baral orders the lifecrafter taken out.
timeline.quote: Mrs. Pashiri seizes and topples, smoke-colored braids flying apart.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
timeline.quote: This was not your fault, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane arrives, the friend Jhoira was waiting for.
timeline.quote: With a rush of wind and golden light, Ajani Goldmane appeared on the shore.

timeline.summary: Ajani meets Jhoira aboard the finished Weatherlight and asks about the planeswalkers he told her of.
timeline.quote: Thank you for meeting me here,

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Jhoira that Karn was rescued from the Phyrexians and has returned to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Were you aware the Planeswalker called Karn was found and rescued from the Phyrexians?

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Venser gave up his spark to save Karn and died.
timeline.quote: Venser gave up his spark to Karn, to rescue him. Venser did not survive.

timeline.summary: Ajani scolds Gideon and Liliana for going to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: You should not have gone to Amonkhet.

timeline.summary: Gideon says they failed on Amonkhet because Liliana's demon pact held her back.
timeline.quote: But we failed on Amonkhet because Liliana was still hamstrung by her demon pact.

timeline.summary: Liliana angrily reveals how much Caligo's ruin matters to her.
timeline.quote: You didn't see what he did to Caligo!

timeline.summary: Ajani departs to find more planeswalkers, leaving Gideon and Liliana to fight Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: I can't help you here. I must find more Planeswalkers to join the battle against Bolas.

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
timeline.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
timeline.quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Vraska introduce themselves; Vraska promises the Golgari will keep the civilians safe.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Golgari territory, Ajani Goldmane. You are safe here.

timeline.summary: Ravnican children and planeswalkers Mu Yanling, Jiang Yanggu and Huatli are lowered to safety through the grate.
timeline.quote: Miss Mu Yanling and Mister Jiang Yanggu

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Heliod runs Elspeth through with Godsend and orders Ajani to carry her to Erebos.
timeline.quote: "Carry her back to the mortal realm, leonin. Deliver her to Erebos,"

timeline.summary: Ajani carries the dying Elspeth to Theros, then leaves to find help as she sees a flash of light cleaving the heavens.
timeline.quote: The last thing she saw was a flash of light, cleaving the heavens in two.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives in New Capenna, wondering whether this is the home Ajani said it would be.
timeline.quote: "Home," Elspeth murmured, seeing if the word fit New Capenna when said aloud.

timeline.summary: A leonin bumps into Elspeth, triggering a memory of her reunion with Ajani on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "You're alive!" Ajani raced to her.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
timeline.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Elspeth that home is a feeling, not a place; she bristles and walks away.
timeline.quote: "Elspeth, home is not a place; it is a feeling.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Ajani reveals he found her home, New Capenna, and asks her to learn how it survived a past Phyrexian incursion.
timeline.quote: "There are rumors of a past incursion there, and since New Capenna is still standing, that means they defeated the previous threat."

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks to New Capenna after Ajani's farewell.
timeline.quote: She didn't look back as she planeswalked away, headed for what she hoped was home.

timeline.summary: Vivien intercepts Elspeth at the drop-off and catches her wrist; Elspeth admits she is learning the plane's history and is there on Ajani's behalf.
timeline.quote: "Ajani sent me."

timeline.summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
timeline.quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani return to Karn's camp, and Karn tells Ajani what he saw of Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: Karn set the box aside. He faced Ajani and related all he had seen.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes speaking to the leaders at the Keldon-Benalish peace summit, and the two planeswalk to Oyster Bay.
timeline.quote: there is a peace summit between the Keldons and the Benalish.

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Karn builds a scrying device and finds he cannot scry Sheoldred; Ajani gives him a copy of the amulet to summon the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: They must have protections in place to prevent us from scrying them.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Karn and Ajani that the Phyrexians have taken Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "but they took Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Karn seizes a thrush that is a Phyrexian spy, which attacks him with corrosive cables, and the group traps it in a cage.
timeline.quote: Karn seized the bird. "I know what you are."

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian knight seizes Aron Capashen and bounds away with Ajani in pursuit.
timeline.quote: It rolled its body around Aron and bounded onto a neighboring balcony.

timeline.summary: Jodah makes locators from samples of the Phyrexian flesh, and Karn watches Ajani in a scryer.
timeline.quote: Ajani seemed to be fighting.

timeline.summary: Jaya meets Ajani and Danitha Capashen, who is searching for her kidnapped father, and joins them to attack the Phyrexian cave.
timeline.quote: "Well, one sure way to get someone out of a cave is smoke."

timeline.summary: Jaya, Ajani and Danitha's forces attack the cave, burning the guards, but are overwhelmed when more Phyrexians pour out.
timeline.quote: The Benalish were being overwhelmed.

timeline.summary: Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, and Danitha stops the fight.
timeline.quote: "If you don't give yourselves up to me," Ertai said

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives on the Golden Argosy and knocks Ertai off the Mana Rig, freeing Karn.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian mage stumbled backwards, concentration broken—and with a scream, tumbled over the side of the Mana Rig.

timeline.summary: Ajani's Phyrexian musculature bursts out and he is revealed as the compleated spy and traitor.
timeline.quote: Ajani had been compleated. He was the spy, the traitor.

timeline.summary: Elspeth asks where Ajani is and Teferi tells her; she reacts with grief and silence.
timeline.quote: Where is Ajani?

timeline.summary: Elspeth apologizes to Teferi, and he tells her about Ajani's compleation.
timeline.quote: I was there with him when it happened—when the compleation took hold.

timeline.summary: Ajani, compleated, quotes Elesh Norn's scripture over Karn as the priests dismantle him.
timeline.quote: Only in her grace are we saved,

timeline.summary: Ajani gives Tezzeret his cloak, once worn by Elspeth, and Tezzeret suspects the true Ajani remains suppressed within.
timeline.quote: it was the same cloak once worn by Elspeth Tirel.

timeline.summary: At a watchtower, Elspeth sets up one of Saheeli's cylinder turrets and tries to pray, remembering that Ajani is compleated.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pulled a steel-clad cylinder from her sack

timeline.summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
timeline.quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

timeline.summary: The group enters Elesh Norn's altar and finds it eerily unguarded, with Kaya suspecting a trap because Ajani may be helping the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: He knows too much about us.

timeline.summary: Compleated Ajani and Tibalt approach on the bridge, with Ajani urging Elspeth to join Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: came Ajani and Tibalt, but not as they had known them.

timeline.summary: Elspeth refuses to join Ajani, who invokes Phyrexia's promise of unity.
timeline.quote: All will be One.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

timeline.summary: On the bridge, Ajani urges Elspeth to join Phyrexia, then attacks her with his axe.
timeline.quote: You do not need to be alive to join Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Tibalt's doubt overwhelms Elspeth, who is disarmed by Ajani and backs away.
timeline.quote: Ajani's next blow knocked the weapon from her hands

timeline.summary: Elspeth's will returns, she blocks Ajani's blow, and Tyvar's magic suppresses Tibalt and the doubt he spreads.
timeline.quote: Your doubt can't touch what it can't reach.

timeline.summary: Elspeth blasts Ajani back with white light and knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: driving him to the ground

timeline.summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
timeline.quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred for craving power over unity, and he beheads her.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred's head bounces to a stop at her feet

timeline.summary: Ajani correctly guesses Theros is his destination, a first-wave target.
timeline.quote: You want to see Theros.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Ajani to bring a guardian god of Theros within Phyrexia's embrace and to bring priests and the Argent Etchings.
timeline.quote: Bring priests with you,

timeline.summary: Ajani departs for Theros while Norn hides her real reason for sending him.
timeline.quote: he did not discover the real reason she'd sent him to Theros.

timeline.summary: Norn reveals a danger to New Phyrexia exists on New Capenna and Theros, which Atraxa and Ajani must seal.
timeline.quote: In killing New Capenna, we strike at her heart.

timeline.summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
timeline.quote: Jaya's dead, Ajani killed her

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He's already changed three of them.

timeline.summary: Heroes of Theros shoot at Ajani, and he has a captured youth killed before the faithful.
timeline.quote: "Behold, one who turns away from the pack! One who plots against us!"

timeline.summary: Elspeth weighs saving Theros against the larger war, and concludes the choice is not meant to be about her own wants.
timeline.quote: But this isn't meant to be about her own wants and needs.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is tempted by Norn's vision of unity with friends such as Ajani and Daxos, but denies they are alike.
timeline.quote: And though she is loath to admit it, there is truth to what Norn is saying.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Karn pulls out Nissa's and Ajani's sparks and gives up Venser's spark to filter them while Melira cleans them.
timeline.quote: "Together, Venser," he says

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
timeline.quote: "She's gone."

timeline.summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
timeline.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's legions attack Norn, and Ajani defends her, until Zhalfirin warriors capture him alive on Teferi's order.
timeline.quote: "Wait! Take that one alive!"

timeline.summary: Chandra helps Nissa melt her Phyrexian carapace and bury it, and reveals she will leave the next day to find Ajani.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Tomorrow, I'm leaving to find Ajani."

timeline.summary: Ajani appears, restored and still a planeswalker, saying he came looking for her and reporting the deaths and survivors among the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Hello, Nahiri," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes that he and Nahiri work together to make amends for what they did, and she refuses.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Someone needs to make amends for what we've done.

timeline.summary: Nahiri suspects Ajani has come to kill her as one of the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: What if he was here to kill her?

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

timeline.summary: Nahiri flings stone to make a wall and the Skyclave dome collapses under her, dropping her onto her cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: and then the dome of the Skyclave collapsed beneath her feet.

timeline.summary: Narset reflects on Ajani, Tamiyo and her lost spark, and Elspeth recalls the cost of bringing Ajani and Nissa back.
timeline.quote: It cost everything to bring him and Nissa back.

timeline.summary: After the damage count, Narset gives Elspeth a guest room and Elspeth says Ajani spoke kindly of her.
timeline.quote: Ajani said very kind things about you.

timeline.summary: Ajani kills a gazelle with his axe and reflects on his guilt over what he did while enslaved to Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Ajani struck, and he struck true: his axe cleaved through the gazelle's neck

timeline.summary: Ajani carries the gazelle home, and something stirs in the dust behind him.
timeline.quote: Behind him, something in the dust woke.

timeline.summary: Nur visits Ajani's hut, teasing him as a hero, and brings food.
timeline.quote: I was given a shameful amount of food and thought I would share it with you.

timeline.summary: Nur calms an ancestral maelstrom of spirits that gather behind Ajani.
timeline.quote: Nur's work proved uncannily effective.

timeline.summary: Over a meal, Nur urges Ajani to accept Abzan help and warns he is dying slowly of spirit.
timeline.quote: This isn't living. This is just a death deferred.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls attacking Jaya on the Mana Rig and answers Nur that his isolation might be punishment.
timeline.quote: Ajani would never forget Jaya's face as she plummeted from the Mana Rig

timeline.summary: Ajani prepares to lead Abzan riders in a gazelle hunt, unsettled by the herd and Nur's words.
timeline.quote: Much to his chagrin, Nur had gotten into his head with that last conversation.

timeline.summary: A wave of magic panics the herd and the Abzan dragons throw their riders as a huge red dragon rises with a flight of smaller ones.
timeline.quote: a dragon of improbable size: red-scaled, triumphant, roaring as dozens of its smaller brethren rose to join it.

timeline.summary: Ajani recognizes the giant dragon as Sarkhan in his transformed dragon form.
timeline.quote: It was Sarkhan in his dragon form.

timeline.summary: Ajani bursts into the chamber to report that Sarkhan has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan Vol has taken control of the wild dragons at the borders.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani are reunited and speak of Melira's sacrifice and the past he cannot leave.
timeline.quote: She died saving me,

timeline.summary: Felothar asks to hear more and Ajani begins to tell his tale.
timeline.quote: And Ajani told his tale.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Felothar to release Narset and Elspeth without waiting for consensus so they can try to quell the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: they need to go on their way to see if there is a way to quell the dragonstorms.

timeline.summary: Felothar frees the three and announces evacuation and fortification of Arashin.
timeline.quote: You three are free to go.

timeline.summary: Felothar declares the Abzan will focus on preparation and dismisses the visitors, providing them with supplies.
timeline.quote: You will be provisioned with whatever you might need.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
timeline.quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Ajani he was forgiven before their fight began, and Narset invites him to help stop the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: You were forgiven before our fight even began.

timeline.summary: Ajani refuses to join them and walks away.
timeline.quote: And he was gone before Elspeth or Narset could say another word

timeline.summary: Ajani, riding with Felothar, sees Narset in danger and decides to leap from his dragon.
timeline.quote: he really could just choose to do something.

timeline.summary: Ajani lands and beheads a creature about to bite Narset, and the Abzan dragons descend upon Sarkhan's flock.
timeline.quote: the dragons of the Abzan clan rose from the storm and descended upon Sarkhan's flock.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
timeline.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, stung with shame, vows to bathe the Multiverse in fire and goes after Elspeth.
timeline.quote: I want to bathe the Multiverse in fire for what it has done to me.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches the falling Elspeth and says he came to fight with her in the present.
timeline.quote: To fight with you in the present.

timeline.summary: Abzan dragons suffer mounting casualties, and Narset, Ajani and Elspeth plan to blind Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: If each of us goes for one of his eyes, we might be able to blind him

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives at Liliana's office at Strixhaven; she guesses someone has died.
timeline.quote: Who died?

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace has died.
timeline.quote: It was such a small word.

timeline.summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
timeline.quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: So Bolas escaped.

timeline.summary: Dina bursts in to report that four students are missing after following a flying creature down an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: We think they fell down an Omenpath, but it closed before we could go after them.

timeline.summary: Ajani offers to try to find the missing students and goes with Dina to the site.
timeline.quote: I can certainly try,

timeline.summary: Dina leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood to search for the four missing students.
timeline.quote: led the two out of the building where Liliana's office was located and across the fields toward the Harrier's Wood.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls up black fog and concludes the students are not dead.
timeline.quote: Like Jace, they aren't dead,

timeline.summary: Ajani finds a blue stitched flower petal and recognizes it as coming from a plane where denizens tailor with flowers, which Liliana identifies as Lorwyn.
timeline.quote: You're hinting at Lorwyn,

timeline.summary: Ajani refuses to take Liliana along and plans to reach the students through a stable Omenpath between Lorwyn and Shandalar.
timeline.quote: I can't take you with me.

timeline.summary: Ajani glows and vanishes to go after the students, and Liliana takes Dina back to campus.
timeline.quote: On the second step, he was gone.

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives near the dolmen gate, fights a Shadowmoor serpent and finds the students' footprints leading away.
timeline.quote: until he finally had no choice but to strike it down.

timeline.summary: Ajani fights a boar and senses how out of sync and unhappy the plane is.
timeline.quote: Beasts of Shadowmoor and beasts of Lorwyn, both driven to attack by the sudden change of day into night.

timeline.summary: Ajani bursts in, drives back the cinders and defies Morcant, then takes Kirol away.
timeline.quote: My name is Ajani, and we are leaving.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.
timeline.quote: Lluwen had an instant to make up his mind.

timeline.summary: Ajani leaps over the elf line carrying Kirol and joins the group.
timeline.quote: The figure became clear as a white-furred leonin, carrying Kirol cradled close against his chest.

timeline.summary: Oko reveals that Liliana knows him as Oko and that he was Oona's first attempt at an heir.
timeline.quote: She knows me as Oko. I was Oona's first attempt at an heir.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Tam's wound by removing the arrow with glowing fingers.
timeline.quote: His fingers glowed white as he eased the arrow out of her flesh, and the injury began to knit up under his touch.

timeline.summary: Oko demands Ajani save his sister and tells him the magic of the plane is fed by story and that only saving the queen will save Tam.
timeline.quote: The magic of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor is fed by story,

timeline.summary: Oko gives the remaining dawnglow to Ajani for Tam's wound.
timeline.quote: He took the vial, tipping its contents out over Tam's wound

timeline.summary: Lluwen slips away to follow Ajani and the students, fearing Morcant, and asks to come along.
timeline.quote: But I helped one of the students, and if I stay here, they will kill me.

timeline.summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

timeline.summary: Liliana scolds Tam and says she will not ask Ajani for another favor, calling Oko a bastard.
timeline.quote: Encounters with that bastard Oko rarely end that well for anyone but him.

timeline.summary: Ajani becomes Kirol's advisor for the Pranticle Peak expedition.
timeline.quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Kirol that trauma awakens a planeswalker's spark and that he lost his brother Jazal.
timeline.quote: I lost my brother, Jazal.

timeline.summary: Ajani slashes the spear and destroys the spirit with his axe, then tells his charge to be more careful.
timeline.quote: He slashed the spear in two, and in the same motion brought the flat of his axe down on the spirit's head.

timeline.summary: Kirol sees the Code Oona message and sets out to help, but runs into Ajani.
timeline.quote: When the five of them had come up with the phrase

timeline.summary: Kirol tells Ajani an archaic carried Jadzi away and Fel is acting strangely; Ajani offers a compromise.
timeline.quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches Kirol and joins the group to help find their friends.
timeline.quote: You might have been clever enough to sneak away, but I was clever enough to know how to find you.

timeline.summary: Dina tries to calm the students at the camp as Sanar spots a green smoke signal from Lluwen.
timeline.quote: That's Lluwen's signal! It must be!

timeline.summary: Masked figures ambush the group with a wave of concussive magic as they follow the smoke.
timeline.quote: It was the last thing he managed to say before the whole group got hit with a wave of concussive magic.

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes bound and finds Chandra Nalaar surrounded by cloaked, mask-wearing figures.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar stood surrounded on all sides by cloaked figures in masks

timeline.summary: Chandra says she must make sure Ajani has not been compromised, and Lluwen reveals the masked figures are Oriq.
timeline.quote: They're the Oriq.

timeline.summary: Chandra explains that the Shattered refused to attack the school and shattered their masks, and she took them under her wing.
timeline.quote: None of the people here attacked the school, Ajani. They all refused.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Ajani that Jace is alive and still inside her head after what he did on Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Jace is alive,

timeline.summary: Ajani insists Jace is dead and unmade, upsetting Chandra.
timeline.quote: He didn't just die; his essence was unmade .

timeline.summary: Ajani tackles Chandra as she prepares to blast the archaic, and Lluwen spots Jadzi in its palm.
timeline.quote: Ajani bowled her over and took them both to the ground.

timeline.summary: Chandra orders the Shattered to keep Ajani's students busy; walls of fire rise and Ajani breaks his bonds.
timeline.quote: The Shattered blazed into action.

timeline.summary: Ajani and Chandra fight, and he pins her in a hold to stop her attacking.
timeline.quote: He slipped one arm under her chin and the other hand behind her head.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls her gathered fire over their heads and burns the giant archaic, which screams in pain.
timeline.quote: And before he could stop her, Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

timeline.summary: The wounded archaic looks down at Ajani and Chandra and tears the ground asunder.
timeline.quote: Then it brought its hand down and tore the ground asunder.

timeline.summary: Elsewhere in the tunnels, Chandra and Ajani argue; she tells Ajani she believes Jace plans to use the huge archaic.
timeline.quote: "I think it's the archaic. The big one."

timeline.summary: Chandra asks Ajani to help her find and kill the huge archaic before Jace can use it, and he agrees to support her.
timeline.quote: "I'll support you, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani walk silently through the tunnels below Titan's Grave.
timeline.quote: Two Planeswalkers trudged through the tunnels below Titan's Grave. Neither of them said a word.

timeline.summary: Chandra stumbles in a vision and Ajani catches her by the cloak, then pulls back his hand mid-pat.
timeline.quote: Ajani caught her by the hood of her cloak.

timeline.summary: Ajani wonders whether Chandra's visions might be Ashiok's work and descends behind her.
timeline.quote: It could be Ashiok planting these images in her head.

timeline.summary: They hear the archaic wail and Jadzi's voice from ahead.
timeline.quote: They heard the archaic before they saw it.

timeline.summary: They find Jadzi healing the wounded archaic in the titan's skull, opposite a snarl-like swirl of energy.
timeline.quote: Jadzi kneeled in its palm, still, working a complex healing spell across its flesh.

timeline.summary: Jadzi warns that something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself.
timeline.quote: "Something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself."

timeline.summary: Chandra says Jace is no longer her friend and Ajani argues they cannot turn their backs on him; she rebukes him.
timeline.quote: I get to decide who my friends are, Ajani,

timeline.summary: The archaic wails and a wave of wrongness hits all three, giving Ajani glimpses of another life before it passes.
timeline.quote: The dizziness lingered.

timeline.summary: A tendril of the nexus touches Ajani's wrist and for a blink he feels his brother beside him.
timeline.quote: A tendril of it wrapped around his wrist, and for the space of a blink he felt his brother standing next to him.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Chandra to work together, and she agrees while privately knowing it is a lie.
timeline.quote: It hurt so bad to lie to him.

timeline.summary: The three of them breathe in time and work to untangle the nexus's threads; Chandra collapses in pain.
timeline.quote: A howl left her as her knees threatened to give out from under her.

timeline.summary: Ajani strikes Chandra's forearm with the flat of his axe, sending her fireball wide.
timeline.quote: he brought the flat of his axe down on her forearm with crushing certainty.

timeline.summary: Chandra declares she will go through Ajani if she must, and Ajani plants himself between her and the archaic, and they begin to fight.
timeline.quote: "I will stand here as long as I am able. Fire can only burn my flesh."

timeline.summary: Ajani bats away a fireball with his axe as he and Chandra fight in the chamber.
timeline.quote: A fireball soared at him.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches Chandra's fist and hurls her into a bone wall, then finds he is proud when she stands up.
timeline.quote: he hurled her across the chamber.

timeline.summary: Chandra, dizzy, hurls a fireball at Ajani, who tanks another jet meant for the archaic.
timeline.quote: he was just in time to tank another jet of fire meant for the archaic.

timeline.summary: Ajani's axe bites Chandra's shoulder and she cauterizes the wound.
timeline.quote: Metal bit into her shoulder.

timeline.summary: Chandra drives a lance of fire into Ajani's thigh, and he tells her to stop hurting her friend.
timeline.quote: She drove a lance of fire into the leonin's thigh.

timeline.summary: Ajani repeatedly throws Chandra away, and each time she gets back up.
timeline.quote: But every time he rebuffed her efforts, she got back up.

timeline.summary: Chandra heats Ajani's axe until he drops it, and pins him to the ground, ready to punch.
timeline.quote: The axe clattered to the ground between them.

timeline.summary: Ajani covers Chandra's hand and says they have been through enough; Chandra gives up and the battle is won.
timeline.quote: And he knew that—for whatever it was worth—the battle was won.

timeline.summary: The students arrive to find Chandra and Ajani injured and leaning on one another.
timeline.quote: Next to her—with her arm slung across his shoulders like a wounded soldier—was Ajani Goldmane.

timeline.summary: A reality-wave freezes Chandra and Ajani mid-stride, and amber from the archaic's spell encases Fel.
timeline.quote: to thicken into amber around him, enveloping the professor before he could react.

timeline.summary: Gold light of unity encases the archaic and settles reality; Chandra and Ajani move again.
timeline.quote: They were encasing it.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani arrive at the flat and tell them that Jace is alive.
timeline.quote: "Jace is alive," Chandra says, and in three words, Vraska's entire world falls apart.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani explain that a gorgon working for Jace kidnapped an oracle, and Vraska deduces he needs knowledge of how planes fuse.
timeline.quote: "There was knowledge he did not possess, specifically about the fusion of planes."

timeline.summary: Loot draws maps for Vraska, and she sends Chandra and Ajani to recruit Garruk on Muraganda.
timeline.quote: If we want a chance at making our way to Jace, then we'll need Garruk's help.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani find Garruk's lodge on Muraganda, guarded by tripwires, and he leads them in.
timeline.quote: This tower of muscles can only be Garruk Wildspeaker.

timeline.summary: Chandra explains that Jace's plan would overwrite the Multiverse, and Garruk says illusions don't smell real to him.
timeline.quote: "They don't smell real."

timeline.summary: Garruk agrees to help in exchange for information about wards, seals and magical containment.
timeline.quote: "I need people who understand wards, seals, magical containment.

timeline.summary: Vraska meets Chandra, Ajani and Garruk after they slog through ooze, and they argue about Liliana, whom Garruk wants revenge on.
timeline.quote: "Stand aside and permit me my revenge," Garruk says with deadly calm. "The witch cursed me."

timeline.summary: The four climb the tower and meet a woman in white who embraces Chandra and says she came willingly.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to be saved. I came willingly."

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra expose the woman as not Liliana, and Vraska punches her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Vraska doesn't hesitate. She swings her legs over the desk and socks Liliana at the angle of her jaw.

timeline.summary: The allies chase through looping halls and burst into Opal's office, where hours have passed and they are injured with lost memories.
timeline.quote: When did I get in a fight ?

timeline.summary: Ajani speaks Greek, Garruk's muscles twitch and Chandra is lost, showing Jace's effects; Opal says they fought Jace three times.
timeline.quote: "Oh, sweetie. You fought Jace three times."

timeline.summary: Vraska and her allies burst into the sanctum and Garruk, Chandra and Ajani collapse asleep at the Theorist's snap while Vraska stays standing.
timeline.quote: The four of them burst into his sanctum, and half a second later, three hit the floor.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells him he is a killer who will murder billions, and he wipes her memory and sends the four out.
timeline.quote: her memory of the last few minutes is resting in the Theorist's hand.

timeline.summary: On the third attempt Vraska says he will not convince them, and the Theorist realizes he can command them instead.
timeline.quote: "I don't need to convince you, " he commands, dark and gentle.

timeline.summary: He orders the others to stop each other, and they fight until he calls it off.
timeline.quote: "Stop the others from stopping me."

timeline.summary: The Theorist disables Chandra's decision-making, ruins Garruk's muscles and steals Ajani's language.
timeline.quote: The Theorist reaches inside Ajani's mind and snatches away an entire language.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes they only fought the Theorist, the worst part of Jace.
timeline.quote: "That's not Jace," Vraska concludes with a sick roil of her guts. "It's just what's left."

timeline.summary: Tam heals the injured allies, restoring Garruk's muscles and Ajani's speech.
timeline.quote: Her eyes light up with blue, and after a long minute, both Chandra and Garruk relax.

timeline.summary: Chandra's cryomancer double appears and attacks the group with ice, and the allies jump out the window into the courtyard.
timeline.quote: "Dad says hi," says her double

timeline.summary: The allies fall into the tower's memory traps and find a marble plain with a well.
timeline.quote: It's an infinite plane of marble, endless and bare, with what looks like a well at the center of it.

timeline.summary: In a lecture hall they find the number of beings in the Multiverse on a chalkboard and meet the Detective, an aberration of Jace.
timeline.quote: Jace steps through, but not the one from upstairs.

timeline.summary: The Detective asks the others to find the rest of his parts and hold them in their minds until they can be unified with the Theorist's body.
timeline.quote: You'll need to find the rest of me.

timeline.summary: Ajani pledges support and the Detective vanishes into Vraska's mind in a blue light.
timeline.quote: His body loses form, a steely blue light turns skin to vapor, and in the blink of an eye he is gone.

timeline.summary: The group sees an illusion of Elesh Norn, compleated Nissa and compleated Jace; Chandra and Ajani charge, but Garruk warns it is illusion.
timeline.quote: Ahead, in a massive room at the base of a massive tree, is Elesh Norn, gargantuan and gleaming, straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: The World Tree booms and knocks everyone down; Garruk holds back Ajani as they escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian World Tree pulses with light, and an immense boom from somewhere inside of it knocks them all to the floor.

timeline.summary: Walking into the Singing City, the group's minds fill with telepathic noise from the voices of others and each other.
timeline.quote: This memory trap is the sensation of not being able to shut out the voices of other minds!

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Vraska she will not witness Jace's passing alone and that she is not helpless in this choice.
timeline.quote: "Vraska, Golgari Queen, is anything but helpless."

timeline.summary: Garruk, Ajani and Chandra reach the portal, but Vraska, compelled by the sphinx, steps off the edge of the building.
timeline.quote: And as easily as one would step off the last stair, she steps over the edge.

timeline.summary: The aberrations vanish from his mind and the heroes rush him, but he freezes them in place.
timeline.quote: The heroes rush the Theorist. Without a second thought, he flicks his hand, and his friends come to a halt, standing perfectly still.

timeline.summary: The Theorist summons portals and his friends' doubles tackle them into the portals, then he weaves the two Multiverses together.
timeline.quote: Each tackles their twin into a different portal.

timeline.summary: The friends beat their doubles, Garruk knocks down the cryomancer, Ajani rips away the Chain Veil, and Chandra sends fire.
timeline.quote: roaring as he rips the ancient artifact away with a swipe of his claws.

timeline.summary: Vraska, in her double's disguise, stabs the Theorist in the heart with a knife while Chandra, Ajani and Garruk emerge from a portal.
timeline.quote: Something sharp pierces the Theorist's heart, and he gasps.

timeline.summary: Jace gives each of his friends a final message, and Liliana forgives him.
timeline.quote: Liliana smiles. I'm sorry, Jace. Rest unburdened.

timeline.summary: Vraska holds Jace's body and weeps as Chandra and Ajani embrace her; Liliana kneels and mourns him.
timeline.quote: Vraska holds the body of her beloved and weeps.

timeline.summary: Jace's spark rises from his chest as a blue light and shoots through an open window; Liliana demands to know what he did.
timeline.quote: the spark continues its climb up, out of his chest

timeline.summary: The tower fades, and the doppelgangers of Chandra, Garruk and Ajani step out of a portal and attack.
timeline.quote: One of the portals in the center of the sanctum glows, and out step their doppelgängers.

timeline.summary: The doubles vanish, and a mage-ring appears as a way home; Ajani and Chandra planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: Liliana sees a flash of light as the two of them planeswalk away.

timeline.summary: Ajani devotes himself to protecting the weak and fighting those who seek to oppress others.
timeline.quote: Ajani devotes himself to protecting the weak and fighting against those who seek to oppress others.

timeline.summary: As a Gatewatch member, Ajani mentors fellow planeswalkers to help them master their gifts.
timeline.quote: As a member of the Gatewatch, Ajani often provides mentorship to his fellow Planeswalkers

relations.note: Her pride is sworn to keep his lands safe.
relations.quote: Our pride is loyal to the great teacher, Ajani.

relations.note: Ajani is her leonin companion.
relations.quote: the human Elspeth Tirel and her leonin companion, Ajani

relations.note: Friends; he searches for her on Theros.
relations.quote: I'm here looking for a friend of mine, a human," said Ajani. "Her name is Elspeth."

relations.note: Old friends; Ajani once counseled him on coexistence with humans.
relations.quote: Ajani had spent long hours in conversation with the young man about the importance of coexistence with humankind.

relations.note: Ajani is a leonin and considers it his people.
relations.quote: His people had been here, recently.

relations.note: Travel together to Nyx.
relations.quote: Elspeth Tirel and Ajani Goldmane, meanwhile, sought to journey into Nyx

relations.note: He calls her Grandmother and is helped by her.
relations.quote: Yes, Grandmother.

relations.note: She helps him and declares him a renegade.
relations.quote: Now keep that bird in one piece.

relations.note: Tamiyo calls him her friend.
relations.quote: Welcome back to Kamigawa, my friend,

relations.note: She was his friend and hero; he keeps her cloak.
relations.quote: This belonged to a friend. Elspeth.

relations.note: He rescued her and she calls him a good man.
relations.quote: That was a very good thing you did, Ajani.

relations.note: He rescues Chandra and Nissa.
relations.quote: in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

relations.note: Ajani calls her Grandmother.
relations.quote: "Grandmother."

relations.note: He calls her little candle.

pages_say.description: The great teacher to whom Nira's pride is loyal.
A leonin planeswalker, Elspeth's companion, who carried her body out of Nyx and has faced an ancient dragon planeswalker.
A white-furred, one-eyed leonin planeswalker from Naya who travels to Theros searching for his friend Elspeth.
A leonin Planeswalker who suspected Kiora was not Callaphe and travels with Elspeth.

A one-eyed white-furred leonin planeswalker from Naya, who wears mechanical gauntlets, tracks Grandmother Pashiri to the Dhund, and has vowed not to kill anymore; he is tracking a man who ordered his friend's village burned.
A leonin planeswalker with a double axe who rescued Chandra and Nissa and has followed Tezzeret's movements for weeks.
A leonin warrior and Planeswalker who rescues Chandra and Nissa from the poison cell.
A leonin planeswalker waiting with Mrs. Pashiri at the ration line.

A leonin planeswalker with a double axe who protects the ground team and calls Chandra little candle.

A leonin planeswalker who left the group on Kaladesh to gather allies and told them of a rendezvous.
A leonin planeswalker who heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
A leonin planeswalker who warned the group about Bolas's power.
A planeswalker who suggested the meeting place and warned against going to Amonkhet.
A planeswalker who arrives in a rush of golden light, the friend Jhoira expected.

A one-eyed leonin planeswalker who arrives with the fighters.

Elspeth's friend and a Gatewatch planeswalker who sent her to New Capenna.
